entries.title: Ezekiel 16:1
segments: ¶Again the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

entries.title: Ezekiel 16:2
segments: "Son of man, cause Jerusalem to know her abominations,

entries.title: Ezekiel 16:3
segments: "and say, 'Thus says the Lord GOD to Jerusalem: "Your birth and your nativity [are] from the land of Canaan; your father [was] an Amorite and your mother a Hittite.

entries.title: Ezekiel 16:4
segments: "[As for] your nativity, on the day you were born your navel cord was not cut, nor were you washed in water to cleanse [you]; you were not rubbed with salt nor wrapped in swaddling cloths.

entries.title: Ezekiel 16:5
segments: "No eye pitied you, to do any of these things for you, to have compassion on you; but you were thrown out into the open field, when you yourself were loathed on the day you were born.

entries.title: Ezekiel 16:6
segments: ¶"And when I passed by you and saw you struggling in your own blood, I said to you in your blood, 'Live!' Yes, I said to you in your blood, 'Live!'

entries.title: Ezekiel 16:7
segments: "I made you thrive like a plant in the field; and you grew, matured, and became very beautiful. [Your] breasts were formed, your hair grew, but you [were] naked and bare.

entries.title: Ezekiel 16:8
segments: "When I passed by you again and looked upon you, indeed your time [was] the time of love; so I spread My wing over you and covered your nakedness. Yes, I swore an oath to you and entered into a covenant with you, and you became Mine," says the Lord GOD.

entries.title: Ezekiel 16:9
segments: "Then I washed you in water; yes, I thoroughly washed off your blood, and I anointed you with oil.

entries.title: Ezekiel 16:10
segments: "I clothed you in embroidered cloth and gave you sandals of badger skin; I clothed you with fine linen and covered you with silk.

entries.title: Ezekiel 16:11
segments: "I adorned you with ornaments, put bracelets on your wrists, and a chain on your neck.

entries.title: Ezekiel 16:12
segments: "And I put a jewel in your nose, earrings in your ears, and a beautiful crown on your head.

entries.title: Ezekiel 16:13
segments: "Thus you were adorned with gold and silver, and your clothing [was of] fine linen, silk, and embroidered cloth. You ate [pastry of] fine flour, honey, and oil. You were exceedingly beautiful, and succeeded to royalty.

entries.title: Ezekiel 16:14
segments: "Your fame went out among the nations because of your beauty, for it [was] perfect through My splendor which I had bestowed on you," says the Lord GOD.

entries.title: Ezekiel 16:15
segments: ¶"But you trusted in your own beauty, played the harlot because of your fame, and poured out your harlotry on everyone passing by who [would have] it.

entries.title: Ezekiel 16:16
segments: "You took some of your garments and adorned multicolored high places for yourself, and played the harlot on them. [Such] things should not happen, nor be.

entries.title: Ezekiel 16:17
segments: "You have also taken your beautiful jewelry from My gold and My silver, which I had given you, and made for yourself male images and played the harlot with them.

entries.title: Ezekiel 16:18
segments: "You took your embroidered garments and covered them, and you set My oil and My incense before them.

entries.title: Ezekiel 16:19
segments: "Also My food which I gave you-the pastry of fine flour, oil, and honey [which] I fed you-you set it before them as sweet incense; and [so] it was," says the Lord GOD.

entries.title: Ezekiel 16:20
segments: "Moreover you took your sons and your daughters, whom you bore to Me, and these you sacrificed to them to be devoured. [Were] your [acts] of harlotry a small matter,

entries.title: Ezekiel 16:21
segments: "that you have slain My children and offered them up to them by causing them to pass through [the fire]?

entries.title: Ezekiel 16:22
segments: "And in all your abominations and acts of harlotry you did not remember the days of your youth, when you were naked and bare, struggling in your blood.

entries.title: Ezekiel 16:23
segments: "Then it was so, after all your wickedness-'Woe, woe to you!' says the Lord GOD-

entries.title: Ezekiel 16:24
segments: "[that] you also built for yourself a shrine, and made a high place for yourself in every street.

entries.title: Ezekiel 16:25
segments: "You built your high places at the head of every road, and made your beauty to be abhorred. You offered yourself to everyone who passed by, and multiplied your acts of harlotry.

entries.title: Ezekiel 16:26
segments: "You also committed harlotry with the Egyptians, your very fleshly neighbors, and increased your acts of harlotry to provoke Me to anger.

entries.title: Ezekiel 16:27
segments: "Behold, therefore, I stretched out My hand against you, diminished your allotment, and gave you up to the will of those who hate you, the daughters of the Philistines, who were ashamed of your lewd behavior.

entries.title: Ezekiel 16:28
segments: "You also played the harlot with the Assyrians, because you were insatiable; indeed you played the harlot with them and still were not satisfied.

entries.title: Ezekiel 16:29
segments: "Moreover you multiplied your acts of harlotry as far as the land of the trader, Chaldea; and even then you were not satisfied.

entries.title: Ezekiel 16:30
segments: "How degenerate is your heart!" says the Lord GOD, "seeing you do all these [things], the deeds of a brazen harlot.

entries.title: Ezekiel 16:31
segments: "You erected your shrine at the head of every road, and built your high place in every street. Yet you were not like a harlot, because you scorned payment.

entries.title: Ezekiel 16:32
segments: "[You are] an adulterous wife, [who] takes strangers instead of her husband.

entries.title: Ezekiel 16:33
segments: "Men make payment to all harlots, but you made your payments to all your lovers, and hired them to come to you from all around for your harlotry.

entries.title: Ezekiel 16:34
segments: "You are the opposite of [other] women in your harlotry, because no one solicited you to be a harlot. In that you gave payment but no payment was given you, therefore you are the opposite."

entries.title: Ezekiel 16:35
segments: ¶'Now then, O harlot, hear the word of the LORD!

entries.title: Ezekiel 16:36
segments: 'Thus says the Lord GOD: "Because your filthiness was poured out and your nakedness uncovered in your harlotry with your lovers, and with all your abominable idols, and because of the blood of your children which you gave to them,

entries.title: Ezekiel 16:37
segments: "surely, therefore, I will gather all your lovers with whom you took pleasure, all those you loved, [and] all those you hated; I will gather them from all around against you and will uncover your nakedness to them, that they may see all your nakedness.

entries.title: Ezekiel 16:38
segments: "And I will judge you as women who break wedlock or shed blood are judged; I will bring blood upon you in fury and jealousy.

entries.title: Ezekiel 16:39
segments: "I will also give you into their hand, and they shall throw down your shrines and break down your high places. They shall also strip you of your clothes, take your beautiful jewelry, and leave you naked and bare.

entries.title: Ezekiel 16:40
segments: "They shall also bring up an assembly against you, and they shall stone you with stones and thrust you through with their swords.

entries.title: Ezekiel 16:41
segments: "They shall burn your houses with fire, and execute judgments on you in the sight of many women; and I will make you cease playing the harlot, and you shall no longer hire lovers.

entries.title: Ezekiel 16:42
segments: "So I will lay to rest My fury toward you, and My jealousy shall depart from you. I will be quiet, and be angry no more.

entries.title: Ezekiel 16:43
segments: "Because you did not remember the days of your youth, but agitated Me with all these [things], surely I will also recompense your deeds on [your own] head," says the Lord GOD. "And you shall not commit lewdness in addition to all your abominations.

entries.title: Ezekiel 16:44
segments: ¶"Indeed everyone who quotes proverbs will use [this] proverb against you: 'Like mother, like daughter!'

entries.title: Ezekiel 16:45
segments: "You [are] your mother's daughter, loathing husband and children; and you [are] the sister of your sisters, who loathed their husbands and children; your mother [was] a Hittite and your father an Amorite.

entries.title: Ezekiel 16:46
segments: "Your elder sister [is] Samaria, who dwells with her daughters to the north of you; and your younger sister, who dwells to the south of you, [is] Sodom and her daughters.

entries.title: Ezekiel 16:47
segments: "You did not walk in their ways nor act according to their abominations; but, as [if that were] too little, you became more corrupt than they in all your ways.

entries.title: Ezekiel 16:48
segments: "[As] I live," says the Lord GOD, "neither your sister Sodom nor her daughters have done as you and your daughters have done.

entries.title: Ezekiel 16:49
segments: "Look, this was the iniquity of your sister Sodom: She and her daughter had pride, fullness of food, and abundance of idleness; neither did she strengthen the hand of the poor and needy.

entries.title: Ezekiel 16:50
segments: "And they were haughty and committed abomination before Me; therefore I took them away as I saw [fit].

entries.title: Ezekiel 16:51
segments: "Samaria did not commit half of your sins; but you have multiplied your abominations more than they, and have justified your sisters by all the abominations which you have done.

entries.title: Ezekiel 16:52
segments: "You who judged your sisters, bear your own shame also, because the sins which you committed were more abominable than theirs; they are more righteous than you. Yes, be disgraced also, and bear your own shame, because you justified your sisters.

entries.title: Ezekiel 16:53
segments: "When I bring back their captives, the captives of Sodom and her daughters, and the captives of Samaria and her daughters, then [I will also bring back] the captives of your captivity among them,

entries.title: Ezekiel 16:54
segments: "that you may bear your own shame and be disgraced by all that you did when you comforted them.

entries.title: Ezekiel 16:55
segments: "When your sisters, Sodom and her daughters, return to their former state, and Samaria and her daughters return to their former state, then you and your daughters will return to your former state.

entries.title: Ezekiel 16:56
segments: "For your sister Sodom was not a byword in your mouth in the days of your pride,

entries.title: Ezekiel 16:57
segments: "before your wickedness was uncovered. It was like the time of the reproach of the daughters of Syria and all [those] around her, and of the daughters of the Philistines, who despise you everywhere.

entries.title: Ezekiel 16:58
segments: "You have paid for your lewdness and your abominations," says the LORD.

entries.title: Ezekiel 16:59
segments: 'For thus says the Lord GOD: "I will deal with you as you have done, who despised the oath by breaking the covenant.

entries.title: Ezekiel 16:60
segments: ¶"Nevertheless I will remember My covenant with you in the days of your youth, and I will establish an everlasting covenant with you.

entries.title: Ezekiel 16:61
segments: "Then you will remember your ways and be ashamed, when you receive your older and your younger sisters; for I will give them to you for daughters, but not because of My covenant with you.

entries.title: Ezekiel 16:62
segments: "And I will establish My covenant with you. Then you shall know that I [am] the LORD,

entries.title: Ezekiel 16:63
segments: "that you may remember and be ashamed, and never open your mouth anymore because of your shame, when I provide you an atonement for all you have done," says the Lord GOD.'"
